name: PG&E Match My Payment Program
description: PG&E matches every dollar you pay up to $1,000 toward past-due balance for households under 400% FPL; currently on hold for 2026
fullDescription: PG&E's Match My Payment Program helps customers reduce past-due balances by matching every dollar they pay, up to $1,000. The program is on hold for 2026 and not accepting new applications.
whatTheyOffer:
- PG&E matches your payments dollar-for-dollar toward past-due bills
- Up to $1,000 in matching funds
- Helps clear past-due balances faster
- Subject to funding availability
- On hold for 2026; REACH and payment arrangements are available in the meantime
howToGetIt:
1. Check PG&E's program page for when applications reopen
2. Household income must be below 400% of the federal poverty level
3. Applications are processed by Dollar Energy Fund
4. Make payments toward your balance
5. PG&E matches each payment up to $1,000 total
keywords: Match My Payment, PG&E, past due, debt, utility bill, payment match, low-income, bill assistance, $1000
